name: CI/CD for Machine Learning & Continuous Training
description: Continuous Integration, Continuous Delivery, and Continuous Training (CT) for ML: automated PR testing with CML, model validation gates, Champion-Challenger evaluation, Canary rollouts, and rollback automation.

subskills.name: CML (Continuous Machine Learning) PR Reports
subskills.description: Using CML in GitHub Actions/GitLab CI to train benchmark models on pull requests, generate markdown reports with loss curves, and post PR comments.

subskills.name: Automated Model Validation Gates & Thresholds
subskills.description: Blocking automated deployment if model metrics (F1, AUC, latency, memory footprint) fail minimum acceptance thresholds in CI.

subskills.name: Champion-Challenger Shadow & Live Comparison
subskills.description: Comparing newly trained Challenger model against live Champion model on fresh production data slices before approving promotion.

subskills.name: Continuous Training (CT) Trigger Architecture
subskills.description: Event-driven retraining triggers (data drift alert, new data arrival in lakehouse) vs scheduled cron triggers, and idempotency.

subskills.name: Canary & Blue/Green Model Rollout Pipelines
subskills.description: Automating progressive traffic shifting (1% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%) with Argo Rollouts or Flagger based on error rates and latency percentiles.

subskills.name: Automated Rollback & Model Health Probes
subskills.description: Instant automated rollback to previous model version if live error rate exceeds threshold (5xx spikes, high latency, prediction drift).

subskills.name: Data Pipeline Unit & Integration Testing in CI
subskills.description: Running pytest test suites with Great Expectations and synthetic mock data on feature extraction code before training pipeline execution.

subskills.name: GitOps for Machine Learning (Argo CD / Flux)
subskills.description: Managing declarative Model Serving manifests in Git repositories and synchronizing state to Kubernetes clusters via Argo CD.
keywords: Git as single source of truth

subskills.name: Infrastructure CI/CD with Terraform & GitHub Actions
subskills.description: Automating Terraform plan and apply in pull request pipelines to provision cloud compute, S3 buckets, and EKS/GKE clusters.

cv.signal: Built enterprise CI/CD/CT pipelines with GitHub Actions, CML, Argo Rollouts, and automated Champion-Challenger validation

linkedin.signal: Continuous Training, CI/CD for Machine Learning, and GitOps endorsements

assessment.signal: Passes CI/CD for Machine Learning & Continuous Training Assessment

junior.description: Configures CML PR reports, writes unit tests for data transforms, and establishes model validation threshold checks.

mid.description: Builds Champion-Challenger validation gates, triggers automated retraining, and manages Canary rollouts with health probes.

senior.description: Establishes enterprise GitOps (Argo CD) for machine learning fleets and automates full-stack cloud infrastructure pipelines.
